text:
mike: FYI — March invoice seems to include a duplicate GPU interconnect egress charge. Two identical lines for the same usage_id.
finance-bot: invoice-alert: flagged possible duplicate charge for invoice INV-2026-03-18-3312 (https://billing.example.com/invoices/INV-2026-03-18-3312)
jess: looking now, pulling the billing export and BigQuery. give me a min.
mike: amounts are large — $12,480.00 each line, usage_id=usg-74a1b
sasha: could be reserved capacity / credit reconciliation tricking the export. sometimes reserved credits generate an adjust line that nets to 0 but shows as a separate positive charge + negative credit.
ryan: or tagging split. some infra creates resources with tag "prod" and others "prod-west" which ends up in two billing groups. might manifest as duplicate-looking lines.
jess: ran a quick query:
```
SELECT usage_id, sku, amount, COUNT(*) as rows
FROM billing_export
WHERE invoice_id='INV-2026-03-18-3312' AND LOWER(sku) LIKE '%egress%'
GROUP BY usage_id, sku, amount
ORDER BY rows DESC;
```
jess: result: usage_id=usg-74a1b | sku=GPU_INTERCONNECT_EGRESS_PREMIUM | amount=12480.00 | rows=2
mike: so the export shows two rows identical. could be provider duplication or exporter duplication.
sasha: I pinged provider support with the usage_id and the invoice link. they asked for the raw event ids.
ryan: can we include event_id in the export? right now we only capture usage_id + invoice_line_item_id. event_id would let us dedupe provider-side adjustments.
jess: quick workaround: filter duplicates by (usage_id, amount, sku, start_time) — but that risks dropping legitimate repeated charges.
mike: provider replied to support thread: "we see two charge events: initial charge and an adjustment emitted by a downstream partner. the adjustment should have netted to zero but the system didn't apply the credit in this invoice. escalation in progress."
finance-bot: ticket created with provider (PR-99821), severity=high, assigned to billing-eng
sasha: while provider investigates, let's create a manual credit so our ledger isn't overstated. I'll open a finance journal entry and create a Zendesk ticket.
ryan: I'll add event_id to the export schema — low-risk change but needs coordination with billing infra and a small schema migration. ETA end of week.
mike: please also add an item to reserved-capacity-runbook: "watch for partner adjustments creating duplicate positive lines; reconcile by usage_id+event_id"
jess: noted. also adding a nightly dedupe job to the billing-reporting bucket to surface duplicates flagged by matching (usage_id, sku, amount, start_time).
sasha: provider updated: "we are processing a reversal; expected posting window 24-48h."
mike: ok keep this thread open until reversal posts. :eyes:
jess: will update here when reversal shows in billing export. :thumbsup:
mike: thanks all, leaving manual credit ticket open until provider confirms reversal.
